$Comment: Mana the carrier regains each second, as a percent of their maximum Mana (0.5 is half a percent a second). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. ziggfreed-common's regen pass pays it to a living player every tick, in a fight too, since mana is what an ability spends. Base 0; a total at or below 0 regains nothing.
